visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: zip Instead of Index Arithmetic
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops compare the words letter by letter with indexes, a flag and a break. Use zip(*words). The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
words = ["cascade", "cast", "castle"]
result = ""
for letters in zip(*words):
    if len(set(letters)) != 1:
        break
    result += letters[0]
print(result)
solution.explanation: zip stops at the shortest word by itself, so the length check, the index and the flag are not needed.
